item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: Upstate Computer-Assisted Language Learning Conference 2027
item.description: Upstate CALL is a one-day conference that provides a venue for teachers and scholars who are interested in computer-assisted language learning and technology in and beyond Upstate New York to exchange ideas, network, and receive valuable feedback on research and/or practices. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: The Journal on Ethnopolitics and Minority Issues in Europe - "Special Issue: Kurdish and European Minority Language Translation in Dialogue" (Jrnl)
item.description: Translation into and out of minority languages in Europe and the Middle East operates under conditions of asymmetric institutional recognition, fragmented standardization, and uneven access to publication and broadcast infrastructures. For Kurdish communities across Iran, Iraq, Turkey, and Syria, as well as in European diasporas, translation constitutes a site where language policy, state power, and minority identity converge. Kurdish is spoken across several states and has no single institution

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 20th European Conference on Formal Description of Slavic Languages
item.description: Formal Description of Slavic Languages (FDSL) is a forum for researchers and scholars to present their linguistic work and discuss issues related to the formal description of Slavic languages. It covers a wide range of disciplines, including phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics, and also including theoretical, experimental and corpus approaches. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Journal of Experimental Pragmatics
item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Journal of Experimental Pragmatics is now live! A new community owned, Diamond Open Access journal dedicated to research on meaning, inference, communication, and language use in context. Built by and for the research community, JXPrag combines transparent peer review, a novel Voluntary Action Editor model, and free publishing for authors. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro - "Issues 1 and 2 2027" (Jrnl)
item.description: We invite you to submit a paper or a book review to the journal Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro, edited by the Department of Linguistics of the Faculty of Letters (University of Bucharest) in collaboration with Bucharest University Press. TAL@ro is designed as a comprehensive and dynamic platform aimed at sparking debates and facilitating dialogue among scholars in various linguistic disciplines (e.g. phonetics, morphology, syntax, lexicology, semantics, pragmatics, sociolinguistics, etc.

item.description: Logos et Littera – Journal of Interdisciplinary Approaches to Text invites submissions for its upcoming non-thematic issue. We welcome innovative original research articles and review articles in linguistics, translation studies, LSP, terminology and literature. We encourage contributions that offer innovative insights, employ diverse methodologies, and engage with theoretical and practical dimensions.
